messages:
anya: Quick sync — MVP freeze in 6 business days. ACME demo asks for tenant routing; infra reports OOM regression on embeddings cache in staging. Straw: MUST: core gen API, single-tenant SSO, telemetry/rollout hooks. SHOULD: emb cache only if safe patch + canary. CUT: tenant routing + advanced admin to v1 unless we ship a demo facade.

rio: Agree. Emb cache risky until infra gives a validated fix. Demo facade sounds reasonable if low lift.

sam: I can build a demo facade (fake tenant selector + sample data) — estimate 2 dev days + 1 UX day. Minimal copy and disabled controls. Keeps sales demos working.

maria: Perf note: without emb cache we see ~18% higher p95 on recommend tests and ~3% CTR drop. If we defer, we need a baseline perf ticket and a flag to measure lift later: `perf/embcache/baseline`.

dev-infra: Root cause likely KV eviction + quant changes. Hotfix rough ETA 4 dev days + 2 validation days. I can try a 48h mitigation spike (2d) to reduce risk but not guaranteed.

anya: Decision rule: if infra posts a validated hotfix + 48h soak by EOD Wed -> include emb cache behind a dark-launch with 1-2% canary and rollback thresholds. Else -> cut emb cache to v1 and ship sam's demo facade. Canary SLA: gen p95 <300ms, error-rate <0.5%, cost delta <1.5x -> else immediate rollback.

rio: If we cut emb cache, add a clear v1 landing window in roadmap and an owner (infra + product).

sam: I'll start the facade spike this afternoon and post an estimate by EOD.

maria: I'll queue the baseline perf run and create `perf/embcache/baseline` ticket. Also add telemetry flags: `feature.embcache` and `exp.embcache.cohort`.

dev-infra: I'll post the mitigation spike results by tomorrow noon. If successful we might do the dark-launch.

deploy-bot: milestone:Q2-MVP readiness updated by anya — status: "scope-decision-pending-infra"

anya: Thanks. Final call tomorrow 10:30. Please put rollback steps in the shipping doc regardless of path. :thumbsup:
